newsitem.title: FINLAND: KONECRANES SAYS HAS $6 MLN KOREAN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: KONECRANES SAYS HAS $6 MLN KOREAN ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish industrial cranes maker KCI Konecranes Internmational Oy said on Tuesday it had won two orders from South Korea worth about six million dollars.
"KCI Konecranes is still strengthening its leading position as the shipyard crane supplier to the South Korean market with these two new orders," Konecranes said in a statement.
Konecranes said it had sealed one deal worth "close to four million dollars" to deliver a 110-tonne shipyard crane to Hanjin Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. in Pusan, South Korea.
The second deal was worth "over two million dollars" and was for design and delivery of components for two shipyard cranes to Halla Engineering & Heavy Industries Ltd , it said.
